description: Ministry of Defence - Award of Sri Lanka Armed Service Long Service Medal and Clasp to the Sri Lanka Air Force
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the award of the Armed Services Long Service Medal to specific named military personnel (including their ranks, service numbers, and names). It involves government personnel changes (military awards) but does not include any detailed descriptions of portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes. The content focuses solely on recognizing individuals for their service, fitting the definition of Type 2 (People Gazette).
